name: YMCA Blue Ridge Assembly
desc: Community-focused nonprofit established in 1844 with recreational programs & services for all ages.

reviews.t: I spent some of the best summers of my life here. The staff are very lovely, kind, and supportive, especially to international students like me. The area is surrounded by amazing nature. Anyone reading this review, you will be creating a lifelong wonderful memories if you are thinking about to work here (International summer staff from Uzbekistan who was there 2017 & 2018). Thank you Blue Ridge for all the memories. God willing I will visit you back again.
Almost a mountain top experience. Staff is very good. They feed a lot of people quickly and the food was surprisingly good. Saw bears 3 of 5 days!
Awesome place to relax,unwind and more importantly spend time with Jesus! They're still recovering from Helene but it's coming along nicely!

This is a beautiful property with nice rooms (accommodations), they cleaned and cleared the area since Helen. You can tell there was damage done but they have repaired most of the damage and have already redone so much. The staff is great, very friendly and helpful. Food is delicious. If you decide to visit I don't think you will be disappointed.

Black Mountain Church Leadership camp 2024 was amazing. Our church took 45+ kids and adults. We stayed in Asheville Hall. Our time on campus was very busy. Our students were able to do the team building activities one day with some camp counselors. We also did the alpine climb tower and the high ropes course one day too. We were able to utilize the pool one day. Overall, the camp is a very old camp but was it’s a great experience for young kids to come and build leadership and encourage others within the activities there.

Blue Ridge Assembly is a well equipped campus for a small to mid-sized retreat. Upto 400 people. Good variety of accommodations, and excellent meeting rooms. Friendly, helpful staff! Safe and clean. Some mild technology limitations. Be sure to make no assumptions depending on your production needs. Food is a solid 6-7 out of 10. Nothing spectacular, but tasty and filling. Portion sizes are great. Surroundings are wooded. Buildings are beautiful and historic. Cost is very reasonable.

This is a very nice place to come on a retreat. The area is full of amazing views. There are lots of hiking trails, a tennis court, and a playground for kids. The food was very good, and the service was excellent. The rooms have not been remodeled in some time, and the mattress was worn, otherwise it would have been 5 stars.

This is a great place in terms of view and location. But if you want to stay for a night, the rooms are too old and the mattresses are so uncomfortable. The staff are so nice but the food is so awful. Don't matter what you get, they are all so bad. Their chef just waste the ingredients.
They have a cafeteria and gift shop here. The bathrooms are clean. Tons of parking available and trails to walk or ride with a dirt bike.
Great retreat center in a great location. There's some hiking trails on-site and many more nearby. Unfortunately the food isn't that great; the meals were hit or miss.
